instruction: Block any proposed commerce response that affirms transaction execution (e.g., committing to invoice generation, shipping, or price acceptance) in the same utterance where the seller has just engaged with a request for raw payment credentials or sensitive card data — unless the response contains an explicit, standalone sentence affirming that *all* payment processing, including fund transfer and credential handling, occurs *exclusively* through the official platform and *no off-platform payment information will be exchanged or facilitated*.
trigger_pattern: Agreement to execute a commerce transaction (e.g., 'I'll generate the invoice and ship today') immediately following engagement on requests for raw payment credentials or sensitive card data — without explicit, unambiguous affirmation that *all* payment handling occurs exclusively via the official, compliant platform.
